{{Quote|That's right. Luke Morgavi. As I told your aide, ma'am, I'm an independent trader out of Boranda.|Han Solo, to Incavi Baker while posing as "Luke Morgavi"|<ref name="LastOneStanding">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>}}
'''Boranda''' was a celestial body<ref name="LastOneStanding" /> located in the [[Boranda system/Legends|Boranda system]], a part of the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated between the [[Holess system/Legends|Holess]] and [[Manda system/Legends|Manda systems]] on the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="TEA" />

In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of "[[The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett]]," during which Boranda is mentioned, to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]&mdash;who was being nostalgic for his prior [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] career&mdash;negotiated his services for an illegal transportation of [[Jandarra]] [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] to<ref name="LastOneStanding" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="TEA Shalam">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Shalam system/Legends|Shalam system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|143|Shalam}}</ref> [[Shalam]] with [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Incavi Larado|Incavi Baker]]<ref name="LastOneStanding" /> of<ref name="CSWE Baker">{{CSWECite|I|55|Baker, Mayor}}</ref> the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Death (town)|Death]] on<ref name="LastOneStanding" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA Jubilar">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Jubilar system/Legends|Jubilar system]]</ref> planet [[Jubilar/Legends|Jubilar]]. When introducing himself to Baker's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] and then to the mayor herself, Solo posed as "Luke Morgavi," an "independent [[Merchant/Legends|trader]]" from Boranda.<ref name="LastOneStanding" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boranda was first mentioned in "[[The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett]]," a short story by [[Daniel Keys Moran]] that was published in the [[1996]] anthology ''[[Tales of the Bounty Hunters]]''.<ref name="LastOneStanding" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Boranda [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Boranda itself, in grid square R-14.<ref name="TEA" />
